name: Price Format 1 Choice
definition: Choice of formats to express a price.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Price expressed as a currency and amount.

Rate.name: Rate
Rate.definition: Price expressed as a rate, ie, percentage.

AmountPricePerFinancialInstrumentQuantit.name: Amount Price Per Financial Instrument Quantity
AmountPricePerFinancialInstrumentQuantit.definition: Price expressed as an amount per a quantity of financial instruments.

AmountPricePerAmount.name: Amount Price Per Amount
AmountPricePerAmount.definition: Price expressed as an amount per another amount.

NotSpecified.name: Not Specified
NotSpecified.definition: The value of the price is not specified.
